text:
Maya Thompson: Quick heads-up — ACME Cloud asked for SOC2 Type II summary + pen-test attestation before the marketplace listing review. Who can own artifact delivery?
Oliver Chen: I can own the SOC2 bundle. What exact files do they want? auditor letter, controls matrix, evidence samples?
Santiago Ruiz: For pen-test they want scope, test window, and witness attestation from the SI. Also network/topology diagrams. Need to confirm NDA status with the SI.
Noah Park: We have a presign flow. Presign links expire 48h by default and live under s3://marketplace-evidence/<partner>/. Add metadata tag `redaction:pending` if screenshots contain PII.
Maya Thompson: @Oliver please collect: 1) auditor letter (PDF), 2) controls matrix (CSV), 3) scoping statement (MD), 4) sample evidence (redacted). Add a README with redaction notes.
Oliver Chen: Got it. ETA EOD tomorrow. I'll redact screenshots first. Any recommended tool?
Security Bot: Use internal redact-tool: `./tools/redact --blur --annotations keep` for screenshots. Reminder: remove user IPs and API keys.
Santiago Ruiz: Pen-test window proposed Tue-Wed next week. SI needs ephemeral API creds and signing witness. @DevEx Bot can you provision ephemeral keys for the SI integrator?
DevEx Bot: Ephemeral key created: id=ephem-71, expires=72h. Access scope: read-only to /prod/marketplace-api. Share link: https://secrets.redwood/ephem-71 (rotates on first fetch).
Oliver Chen: Presign flow question: can I request a longer TTL for the auditor? They need 7 days to download.
Noah Park: We can extend TTL per request but must add `access_approval:legal` tag. I'll approve 7d for auditor@example.com if legal signs off.
Priya Rao: Legal: ok to approve 7d for a named third-party auditor. Also confirm we can say "SOC2 Type II in scope" in announcement once redaction + attestation are complete.
Maya Thompson: Good. Also marketplace asks for a short attestation string for listing copy. Legal to provide final wording pls.
Priya Rao: Draft wording: "Redwood Inference maintains SOC2 Type II controls over our inference platform; relevant artifacts are available to authorized auditors." Happy to refine.
Santiago Ruiz: SI integrator: please confirm they can witness the pen-test and sign attestation. @Oliver I'll loop them in after NDA.
Oliver Chen: Looping SI contact in DM now. Will request witness attestation template.
Security Bot: Quick checklist before upload: - remove PII - sanitize access logs (redact IPs) - strip any customer identifiers - include a controls mapping file.
Maya Thompson: Action items recap: Oliver upload SOC2 artifacts + README with redaction notes; Santiago confirm pen-test scope and SI witness; DevEx provide ephemeral creds (done); Legal finalize announcement wording. Keep updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
Oliver Chen: On it — I'll post presign link when artifacts are ready.
Priya Rao: I'll post the approved announcement blurb here once finalized.
Noah Park: If you need a one-off S3 prefix created for ACME, ping me and I'll provision with proper ACLs.
Maya Thompson: Thanks team — try to have artifacts and pen-test scope locked in by COB tomorrow so we can unblock marketplace intake.
Security Bot: FYI I scheduled a quick evidence review slot tomorrow 10:30am PT. Join if you want a quick sanity check.
Maya Thompson: Perfect, see you then.
